page.overview:
Who is Blackwater Prison Warden?

The Warden was the head of Blackwater Prison used to hold important military prisoners. He met with Gung-Ho and his team who were escorting Cobra Commander after capturing him in a desert highway battle. The warden congratulated the team for their fine work but showed disgust at parole board head Dr. Cassels's comments about reforming Cobra Commander. He was shortly after knocked out with sleeping gas used by Dr. Cassels and Colonel Sharp who were revealed to be Baroness and Zartan in disguise.
